meta.name: CW Presents WWE NXT
meta.description:
The Future of wrestling is here! Watch all your favorite WWE NXT superstars 24/7. Don't miss all the Big Energy, Big Hits, and Big Moments as the next generation of WWE Superstars enter the ring for battle in their rise to fame.

Shows: WWE NXT, WWE NXT: The Great American Bash 2026, WWE NXT: Heatwave 2026
Available on: Pluto TV, The Roku Channel, Plex
